definitions.short: amplitude , i.e. (concrete) a mantle ; also (figuratively) splendor
definitions.full: H145. eder אֶ֫דֶר noun [masculine] 1 glory, magnificence (Assyrian aduru , adiru ) ironical of price of shepherd (symbolic) Zech 11:13 . 2 mangle, cloak (as wide ) Micah 2:8 (|| שַׂלְמָה ), but read אדרת ( ת lost before following ת ), so WRS Proph 427 .
